tool_args.rationale: The leading mechanism is the archived coupled memory ODE, with raw-prefix data available to infer the initial memory state. The current five observations are below its stated eight-row fitting requirement, so acquire the fine trajectory batch before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled two-state memory ODE from the five existing rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The archive specifies four fitted parameters and requires at least eight rows; five rows leave the dynamics insufficiently identified.

The endpoint-matched-history gap and coupled transient-lag signatures support the memory ODE, while the open-branch probe targets branch and sink-gradient ambiguity not indicated by these observations.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static or before/after contrast model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These do not capture the observed history dependence and transient lag.
